title: Tensor comparison identity, tower and common-stage inclusion cocycles
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D$ and its coefficient datum $c$, and the common-stage operation data $A$ of [def-fix-six-functor-datum]. Use the rational finite coefficient stages and common-stage category of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. Define tensor coefficient coherence for $A$ by the following three equations, for every compactified square $Q$, scheme $X$, and objects $M,N$ at a finite coefficient field $E$. Write $T_h$ for the specified transition for $h:E\subset F$, $u_E:T_{E,E}\cong1$ for its normalized unitor, $a_{h,h'}:T_hT_{h'}\cong T_{h'h}$ for its associator, $i_E$ for common-stage inclusion, and $d_h:T_hi_F\cong i_E$ for its comparison. Write $\alpha_h:T_h(M\otimes_E N)\cong T_hM\otimes_F T_hN$ and $\beta_E:i_E(M\otimes_E N)\cong i_EM\otimes i_EN$ for the tensor components of the recorded coefficient and inclusion exchange comparisons at $Q,X$. Composition below is read from left to right. (1) Identity: $\alpha_{E,E};(u_E(M)\otimes u_E(N))=u_E(M\otimes_E N)$. (2) Tower: for every $E\subset F\subset G$, $T_{h'}(\alpha_h);\alpha_{h'}(T_hM,T_hN);(a_{h,h'}(M)\otimes a_{h,h'}(N))=a_{h,h'}(M\otimes_E N);\alpha_{h'h}(M,N)$. (3) Inclusion: for every $h:E\subset F$, $(d_h(M)\otimes d_h(N));\beta_E(M,N)^{-1}=\beta_F(T_hM,T_hN)^{-1};i_F(\alpha_h(M,N)^{-1});d_h(M\otimes_E N)$. The tensor functor in each displayed factor is the specified tensor at that factor's target. Repeated fields and identity inclusions are included. This defines a predicate on the recorded data; it changes no operation datum and asserts no projection invertibility.
